A new era of

Twenty industrial flex condominiums in two new rear-load buildings in the Park of Broken Sound, on one of the last developable sites inside Boca Raton's industrial park. Each unit runs 3,581 square feet, with a 550 square foot mezzanine over the office. Buy one, or combine adjacent units.

10 reasons to own

01Own your space for the cost of leasingDebt service is comparable to market rent in Boca, and it builds your balance sheet.
02As little as 10% downSBA 504 may be available to qualified owner-occupants, fixing 40% of the debt for 25 years.*
03Fix your occupancy cost permanentlyNo renewal negotiations, no market resets, no annual escalations you do not control.
04Capture the appreciation yourselfBoca Raton industrial has no land supply left. Value accrues to the owner, not the tenant.
05Deduct interest and depreciate the assetInterest is deductible and the building depreciates against income.
06Build the space around your operationSpecify your own power, finishes and buildout. No landlord consent, no restoration.
07Buy for where you are goingAdjacent units can be combined at purchase, so you size today against tomorrow's headcount.
08Never move againLocation stability protects your workforce, your customers, and the goodwill in your address.
09A park of owners, not tenantsOwner-occupants maintain their buildings and hold the standard of the park. Turnover is minimal.
10A transferable, financeable assetSell it, hold it as retirement income, or lease it to your successor.

The site.

The property fronts Broken Sound Boulevard NW, with lake frontage east and the Broken Sound Club golf course wrapping west and south. The two buildings face one another across a shared interior court, so loading is concealed from the street and every unit presents a glass storefront and its own entry to landscaped parking. At 2.7 spaces per 1,000 square feet, the site parks well above a typical industrial condominium.
